# cell_barcode_assignment.R

## cell_barcode_assignment()

```{r}
list_BC1 <- readRDS("data/list_BC1.rds")
list_BC2_3 <- readRDS("data/list_BC2_3.rds")
cell_to_extracted_BCs <- readRDS("data/cell_to_extracted_BCs.rds")
head(cell_to_extracted_BCs)
```

```{r}
cell_barcode_assignment(
  cell_to_extracted_BCs = cell_to_extracted_BCs,
  list_BC1 = list_BC1,
  list_BC2_3 = list_BC2_3,
  BC_thresholds = list(BC1_threshold = 3, BC2_3_threshold = 5),
  reads_thresholds = list(min_reads = 5, min_reads_proportion = 0.9),
  output_dir = "data"
)
```
